advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm `_TICKET_ID_RE` should match numeric-only grouped tokens (dates/numeric ids), or tighten it / add a negative test for a non-ticket grouped token.
evidence: The character class `[0-9a-f]` admits digits, so `2024-1231` (a date) satisfies `[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}` and would be reported as a ticket id.
ABSENCE: no test covers a numeric-but-non-ticket grouped token in a marker pointer; tests only exercise the true-positive `dce2-b93d[-4112-451c]` and pointers with no grouped token.
advisory.finding: `_TICKET_ID_RE` (`[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}...`) matches any grouped-hex token including purely-numeric ones, so a `# read-via:` pointer containing a numeric grouped token (e.g. a date `2024-1231`, or a numeric identifier) would be misclassified as a rebar ticket id and produce a spurious report line.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a reporter test asserting a legitimate reader pointer containing a hex-shaped token (e.g. `# read-via: consumer.py rev abcd-1234`) is NOT emitted as a ticket-parked report.
evidence: scripts/check_config_reads.py:462: `ticket_ids = _TICKET_ID_RE.findall(pointer)` — any pointer matching the 4-4 grouped-hex shape is reported as a ticket

tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_heldout.py:281: the only tested non-ticket reader pointer is `# read-via: consumer.py getattr dispatch`, which has no hex-group token, so it exercises the empty-`findall` path trivially

ABSENCE: no test supplies a `# read-via:` reader pointer containing a `[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}` token to assert it is NOT reported; a regression widening/loosening the classifier over a real-reader pointer would go undetected
advisory.finding: The new ticket-classification regex `_TICKET_ID_RE` is never tested for false positives against a legitimate reader pointer that contains a hex-shaped token (e.g. a commit sha fragment like `abcd-1234` or a file/offset). The only negative case tested is the plain-prose pointer `consumer.py getattr dispatch`, which contains no hex-group token, so it cannot catch a regression where a real reader pointer is misclassified as a parked-ticket marker and spuriously reported.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a negative case to test_a_marker_pointing_at_a_ticket_is_reported (or a sibling) with a reader pointer such as `# read-via: consumer.py commit abcd-1234 dispatch`, asserting `gate.ticket_pointer_reports(schema)` does not include that field — pinning that only genuine ticket-id pointers are classified.
